title: FilterLite Shaders
description: A lightweight, screen-space post-processing shader focused entirely on color grading and camera filters. Features 20 built-in presets (Cinematic, Vintage, Lo-Fi, etc.) with minimal FPS impact.
body:
# FilterLite Shaders

A pure post-processing shader designed to act like a built-in Lightroom / camera filter for your game. 

It doesn’t add heavy dynamic shadows, waving leaves, or realistic water-instead, it focuses 100% on screen-space color manipulation. The result is a photographic look that runs on literally any machine.

## Features

* **Full Color Grading Suite:** Manual control over Exposure, Contrast, Saturation, Temperature (Kelvin), and Tint.
* **Camera Effects:** Toggleable Sepia, Screen Vignette, and dynamic (animated) Film Grain.
* **20 Built-in Profiles:** Don't want to tweak sliders? Just pick a preset:
  * *Clean & Natural:* Default, Lark, Reyes, Ludwig, Perpetua
  * *Warm & Cozy:* Gingham, Slumber, Crema, Aden, Seventies, Toaster
  * *High Contrast / Vibrant:* Clarendon, Juno, Lo-Fi, Kelvin
  * *Retro & Monochrome:* Moon, Inkwell, Vintage, Nashville, Cinematic
* **Zero Lag:** Built on standard `#version 120` GLSL math. If your PC can run the base game, it can run this at full speed.

## Compatibility

* Fully compatible with **Iris Shaders** and **OptiFine**.
* Version agnostic (Works on virtually any Minecraft update).

## How to install

1. Download the `.zip` file.
2. Drop it into your `shaderpacks` folder.
3. Select it in-game and use the Shader Options menu to pick your favorite profile.
